notes.title: Update : fixed controls and removed unnecessary scenes
notes.content:
At the request of the players, the controls were redesigned and we decided to change the controls to a more convenient one. And also removed intermediate scenes that lasted a long time, according to the players. Minor bugs have also been fixed.
